specific_objectives: 33.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain historical development of ejection seat

practical: Review of ejection seat components diagram; Instructor supervision required for safety briefing
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an ejection seat?
Name one historical milestone in ejection seat development.
Why is the historical development of ejection seats relevant to current engineering?

topics: Transition from rocket to pneumatic systems
development.content:
Early ejection seat concepts
Transition from rocket to pneumatic systems
Introduction of the Martin-Baker Mk 1
Evolution of safety harnesses
Development of zero-zero capability

Canopy jettison mechanisms
Seat cushioning and deceleration systems
Parachute deployment sequence
Emergency release systems
Maintenance access points

Integration of electronic safety systems
Modern redundancy features
Testing and certification standards
Future trends in ejection technology
Impact on pilot survivability

summary_questions: Explain how the historical development of ejection seats improved pilot survival rates.
Describe the purpose of the canopy jettison mechanism in a typical ejection seat.
Identify three main parts of an ejection seat and their specific functions.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the historical development of ejection seats influenced the design of modern ejection systems, to be discussed in the next lesson plan.
